questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Among the following, glucarpidase is used in which condition?

options.label: B
options.text: Treatment of toxic plasma methotrexate concentrations

options.label: C
options.text: To counteract the activity of asparaginase

options.label: D
options.text: To prevent cardiotoxicity induced by dactinomycin

questions.answerText: Treatment of toxic plasma methotrexate concentrations
questions.solutionHtml:
Treatment of toxic plasma methotrexate concentrations
  • Glucarpidase is a carboxypeptidase enzyme indicated for the treatment of toxic plasma methotrexate concentrations (>1 micromole per liter) in patients with delayed methotrexate clearance due to impaired renal function.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Chapter 66, Page No. 1180

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Which of the following is not a mechanism for Methotrexate resistance?

options.label: C
options.text: Increased ability to synthesize methotrexate polyglutamate

options.label: D
options.text: Increased expression of a drug efflux transporter

questions.answerText: Increased ability to synthesize methotrexate polyglutamate
questions.solutionHtml:
Increased ability to synthesize methotrexate polyglutamate
  • It is a mechanism by which MTX produces long-term action, not resistance


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Chapter 66, Page No. 1179

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Which of the following statement is false about Fulvestrant?

options.label: A
options.text: It is a selective estrogen receptor down regulator (SERD)

options.label: B
options.text: better safety and faster onset of action than Tamoxifen

options.label: C
options.text: short duration of action than tamoxifen

questions.answerText: short duration of action than tamoxifen
questions.solutionHtml:
short duration of action than tamoxifen
  • Fulvestrant has better safety, faster action, and longer duration of action than tamoxifen


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 337

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: A 12-year-old girl visits her physician for follow-up after treatment with methotrexate for acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Stool analysis reveals blood in the stool. Her platelet count is very low. Which of these substances should be administered immediately?
questions.solutionHtml:
Leucovorin
  • This patient is having methotrexate toxicity presenting with decreased platelet count (reveals blood in stool)
  • The antidote for this is Leucovorin


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 921

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Which of the following drug is a combination of IL-2 with diphtheria toxin and used for cutaneous T-cell lymphoma?
questions.solutionHtml:
Denileukin diftitox

Antineoplastic agent, an engineered protein combining interleukin-2 and diphtheria toxin. Denileukin diftitox could bind to interleukin-2 receptors and introduce the diphtheria toxin into cells that express those receptors.



Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Chapter 67, Page No. 1229

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Following drugs are used in multiple myeloma except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Temozolomide

It is used in the treatment of specific types of cancer of the brain. It is used to treat brain tumors if they return or get worse after standard treatment. It may be also used to treat other conditions, as determined by the doctor.



Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Chapter 66, Page No. 1197

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Which of the following anticancer drug lead to a hyper coagulated state?
questions.solutionHtml:
L-Asparaginase

It is used to treat acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and lymphoblastic lymphoma (LBL). It is given by injection into a vein, muscle, or under the skin. A pegylated version is also available.



Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition Chapter 66, Page No. 1200

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: All of the following anticancer agents cause bone marrow suppression except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Flutamide
  • Flutamide is used in the treatment of cancer of the prostate gland. It may be also used to treat other conditions, as determined by the doctor. It works by blocking the effects of male hormones such as testosterone.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 932

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Among the following options, what is the mechanism of action of pentostatin:
questions.solutionHtml:
Adenosine deaminase enzyme inhibition
  • Pentostatin is used to treat hairy cell leukemia. It is given by intravenous infusion once every two weeks for three to six months.
  • Additionally, pentostatin has been used to treat steroid-refractory acute and chronic graft-versus-host disease. Pentostatin is also used in chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) patients who have relapsed.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 989

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: FDA-approved drug for the treatment of breast cancer which is ER-positive:
questions.solutionHtml:
Tamoxifen
  • It is a medicine used in the treatment of breast cancer in both men and women. It is also used to reduce the risk of breast cancer in women with a high chance of developing it. This medicine helps to slow down the growth and multiplication of cancer cells.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 338

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: All are true for immunosuppressants except:

options.label: A
options.text: Sirolimus acts by T cell proliferation

options.label: C
options.text: Mycophenolate acts by inhibiting GMP dehydrogenase

options.label: D
options.text: Cyclosporin is integral in transplant rejection regimen.

questions.answerText: Mycophenolate acts by inhibiting GMP dehydrogenase
questions.solutionHtml:
Mycophenolate acts by inhibiting GMP dehydrogenase
  • Mycophenolate is a prodrug of mycophenolic acid which selectively inhibits inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase thus inhibiting lymphocyte proli¬feration, antibody production, and cell-mediated immunity.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 942

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Among the following options, High dose methotrexate is given in:
questions.solutionHtml:
Osteosarcoma
  • Can mimic growing pains — pain in the legs caused by normal bone growth. However, growing pains typically stop during the early teenage years. Contact a doctor if your child has any chronic bone pain or swelling past their initial growth spurts, or if the pain is causing your child serious issues. 


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 921

questions.topic: eGurukul · Hormonal Agents & Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
questions.stem: Which of the following is an antimetabolite:
questions.solutionHtml:
Methotrexate
  • It is a medicine used to treat rheumatoid arthritis where it can prevent further joint damage. It is also used to treat severe forms of a skin disease called psoriasis by killing cells in the skin which are growing too quickly and to treat tumors in a range of cancers.
  • Option: A. Methotrexate - Antimetabolite


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 921
